d: A dark forest scattered with ancient plants that form almost a labyrinth around a steep mountain, at the slopes of which there was the entrance of a sacred cave to the deities of Havern. Great, preceding Aegean, and choir of Donzelle followers of Medea, who with Leucippe meet in the cave.
Medea and sayings.
Evandro, hasty, and sayings.

Internal view of the walls of Athens with great practicable door. Choir of Athenians of the one, and of the other sex, which carry crowns of laurel and palm branches. Evandro, then Theseus and Asteria in a big adorned with trophies that are mentioned below.
Aegean with Sèguito: then Medea with Leucippe, and sayings.
Medea and Leucippe.

Temple of Love, and of Hymenaeus, with simulacrums of these divinities before which burning plow. Aegean, Theseus, Asteria, Evandro, Priests with cup for the oath, and other instruments similar to sacrifices; Great, and People.
Hurrying connida and sayings.
Connida, alone.
Royal apartments with open loggias, corresponding on the large squareTeseo followed by Asteria.
Aegean and Medea.
Asteria and sayings.
Theseus with Connida, Chorus, and sayings.
Wood consecrated to Hecate. Night with moon. Connida, Evandro, indi Leucippe.
Leucippe, and Medea in a style.
Aegean with Asteria and sayings.
Gallery of statues, with marble seats. Theseus on one of them asleep, and Leucippe advancing cautiously, then Aegean.

Dettali and Asteria hasty holding the blow, and takes the iron away from their father, Theseus wakes up, rises up with impetus, and in the act of wanting to bare the sword, he sees Asteria, who holds the style, and is surprised.
Connida and said.
Leucippe holding Connida.

The inner part of the cave dedicated to the infernal divinities, and from whence they used to answer, and give the oracles. The same shows that it is from the nature hollowed in the bowels of a mountain, and in it for a steep and rough staircase from the high descent. There are various mouths wide open here, and there, from which mixed with flames, the voices of the inhabitants of Avern come out; and from the greater of these, which continually erupts fire springs forth in its time the shadow of Etra. Theseus descending from above with signs of surprise and horror; and the invisible Chorus of hellish divinities.
The Shadow of Etra, Theseus, and the Invisible Choir.
Royal apartments with loggias as above. Medea, Evandro, and a Donzella with a undercup, above which the cup, which then is named, which comes from Evandro taken, and delivered to a Guard.
Aegean, Asteria, Evandro, Connida, Leucippe, choir of Grandi, and People, then Theseus.
Theseus, Asteria, Evandro, and Connida.
Aegean, and sayings.
Medea appears high above a chariot pulled by two dragons, who vomit fire, and dropped to a certain term stops over a group of clouds.
